 Written Statement on behalf of Defendant s No. 01 and 02 
 
 The Defendant s most respectfully submits as under: 
 
 This written reply is being submitted by M/s Zameen Medallion ( Pvt .) Lt d . Defendant No. 02 and Defendant No. 01 who is an employee of Defendant No. 02 (hereinafter, the Answering Defendant s ). This written reply is being submitted by the Defendant s through Mr. Syed Hasan Ali Shah who is fully conversant with the facts of the case and has been duly authorized in this behalf. 
 
 Preliminary Objections: 
 
 That the instant suit is not maintainable to the extent of the Answering Defendant s . It may kindly be noted that the Answering Defendant s do not have any obligation towards the Plaintiff under any contract etc . Thus, to the extent of the Answering Defendant s , the instant suit is bad for misjoinder . Thus, the suit is liable to be dismissed . 
 
 That following from the above, since the Answering Defendants has no concern and connection with the transaction in question, as much as, it relates to the Plaintiff . Thus , the name s of the Answering Defendants, having been impleaded wrongly, should be struck out from the array of defendants under Order I, Rule 10 (2). 
 
 That on the basis of the facts stated in paragraph (1) ( above ), the Plaintiff cannot possibly have a cause of action against the Answering Defendants, therefore, to the extent of Answering Defendants, the plaint is liable to be rejected under Order VII , Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure , 1908. 
 
 ON MERIT S : 
 
 Note: Pertains to record and n eed s no reply . 
 
 INTRODUCTORY: 
 
 That the contents of the corresponding para are incorrect as stated. The Defendants does not have any office at the given address. 
 
 That the contents of the corresponding para are irrelevant or at least do not pertain to the Answering Defendant s . The Plaintiff is put to strict proof. 
 
 That the contents of the corresponding para are denied being false and misleading. However, for clarity, it is submitted that ‘Zameen.Com’ is merely a brand name owned by M/s Zameen Media (Pvt.) Ltd. As such, the Answering Defendants do not have any concern with buying and selling of properties by real estate developers. Defendant No. 2 is not a subsidiary of any other company, and it cannot possibly be a subsidiary of ‘Zameen.com’ as the latter is not a person juristic person. Defendant No.2 is not involved in any kind of services relating to property development, sales and related real estate services. 
 
 ON FACTS: 
 
 That the contents of the corresponding para are denied being false and misleading . The Plaintiff booked Shop No. 08, Ground Floor, m easuring 206.15 Square Feet (the ‘Suit Property’ ) in the Project called V9 Mall and Residency Islamabad . Th e said Project is owned by a Partnership Firm named “ V9 Mall ” (the ‘ Developer ’ ) , having its place of business at Plot No. 068, Street B, Theme Park, Bahria Springs Commercial, Phase VII, Islamabad. The Answering Defendants o n ly collected down payment against sale of aunit in the Project on behalf of the Developer. If at all the Plaintiff has any claims, it is against the Developer and not the Defendants . 
 
 That the contents of the corresponding para are denied being misconceived. It is clarified that the Plaintiff actually made payment for the Suit Property of the Developer through Answering Defendants. Accordingly, the payment was remitted the Developer/Owner of the project, by the Answering Defendants. The Answering Defendants merely worked as a conduit to receive payment on behalf of the Developer. As such, there is no privy of contract between the Plaintiff and the Answering Defendants and it does not have any ownership rights or any other rights in the Suit Property . 
 
 That the contents of the corresponding para are denied being misconceived. The Answering Defendants has no any contractual obligation towards the Plaintiff. T he Plaintiff is put to strict proof of his claims. Moreover, the contents of the Preliminary Objections and Reply to Para No. 0 2 ( above ) are reiterated here.

 APPLICATION UNDER ORDER 39 RULE 1 AND 2 READ WITH SECTION 151 CPC . 
 
 Written Reply on behalf of Defendant No. 01 and 02 
 
 
 Preliminary Objections: 
 
 
 The Applicant has no locus standi to file the titled Application and also this application. Application under reply is liable to be dismissed forthwith . 
 
 To obtain interim relief an applicant has to prove existence of three ingredients which are ( i ) prima facie case; (ii) irreparable loss and (iii) balance of convenience. All three factors should co-exist for being granted an interim injunction to an applican t. However, in the Application under reply the Applicant has miserably failed to show how a prima facie case exists in his favour and what irreparable loss s he would suffer. The application under reply is liable to be dismissed on this score. 
 
 Para wise Reply: 
 
 Para under reply pertains to record. 
 
 Para under reply is incorrect and misleading. The contents of Preliminary objections ( above ) and the Reply to the main suit are reiterated here. 
 Para under reply is incorrect and misleading. The contents of Preliminary objections ( above ) and the Reply to the main suit are reiterated here.

 Wherefore, it is most respectfully prayed that the titled appl ication may kindly be dismissed forthwith with special costs under the Islamabad Cost of Litigation Act, 2017.
